title: 第17章 打造武器第18章 热武器对上冷兵器
slug: 饥荒年我囤货娇养了古代大将军
lines: 战家军只剩两万人，没有战马，没有好的武器。
城内有水的消息一旦透露出去，漠北蛮王定会攻城，他哪怕付出极大代价也在所不惜。
因为这是救命的水源！
战承胤站起身，棱角分明的俊脸剑眉紧拧。
他在营帐中来回踱步。
守门的士兵见状，知道将军心烦。
屏退所有人，自己则退出帐外数米远。
忽地，战承胤营帐上空，无数袋煤渣和木炭像雨一样掉落下来。
哗哗哗……
煤炭积满了整个帐篷。
直至他的帐篷再也装不下，撕拉一声爆裂。
煤渣木炭像雪崩一样，从营帐中滚出来，滚了一地！
士兵听到响动，连忙跑过来。
只见战承胤周围两米直径内，没有东西掉落，他安然无恙矗立原地。
士兵们把煤渣和木炭小心翼翼的移开。
虽心有疑惑，将军营帐刚才空空如也，怎会多出如此多木炭和黑色碎渣。
战承胤表情淡然，手提花瓶从破碎帐篷中走出。
他见到满地的煤渣，蹲下，捏了手上的煤。
照视频所说，煤能烧很长时间，制作成煤球能燃两个时辰。
比木材温度高，更持久！
这煤可是锻造武器的好燃料，比木炭更耐用。
可惜，这里没有铁石，亦没有青铜矿石，无法铸成兵器。
不然军中将士的兵器可以重新铸造！
就在他心有所想的下一瞬~
哗哗哗……
无数钢管从天而降！
钢管粗壮，有小孩手腕大，被截成一条条，整整齐齐落在他面前。
堆成一堵高墙！
钢管数量之夸张，比昨日掉下满院子的蔬菜还要壮观！
这，是精铁？
还是精钢？
在整个大启国，青铜器物横行，连钱币都是青铜铸造。
铁是稀罕物，钢堪比黄金贵重。
听到动静的将士们，纷纷跑出来，看见钢管成堆整齐摆放。
他们全部愣住，满目震惊！
林大钧瞪大眼睛走上前，伸手触摸冰冷的钢管……
再用手敲了敲。
是钢！
content_en:
There are only 20,000 people left in the Zhan family's army, with no horses and no good weapons.
Once the news that there is water in the city is revealed, the Mobei Barbarian King will definitely attack the city, even if he pays a huge price.
Because this is a life-saving water source!
Zhan Chengyin stood up, his angular handsome face and eyebrows tightened.
He paced back and forth in the camp.
When the soldiers guarding the gate saw this, they knew that the general was upset.
Screen everyone away and retreat a few meters away from the tent.
Suddenly, countless bags of cinders and charcoal fell like rain from the sky above Zhan Chengyin's camp.
Hua Hua Hua...
Coal filled the entire tent.
Until his tent could no longer hold it, and it tore and exploded.
The cinders and charcoal rolled out of the tent like an avalanche and rolled all over the ground!
"General..."
The soldiers heard the noise and ran over quickly.
Nothing fell within two meters around Zhan Chengyin, and he stood on the spot safe and sound.
The soldiers carefully removed the cinders and charcoal.
Although I have doubts, the general's camp was empty just now, how could there be so much charcoal and black debris.
Zhan Chengyin's expression was indifferent and he walked out of the broken tent with a vase in his hand.
When he saw the cinders on the ground, he squatted down and pinched the coal in his hand.
According to the video, coal can burn for a long time, and briquettes can burn for two hours.
Higher temperature than wood and longer lasting!
This coal is a good fuel for forging weapons and is more durable than charcoal.
Unfortunately, there is no iron stone or bronze ore here to make weapons.
Otherwise, the weapons of the generals can be recast!
The very next moment he had something in mind~
Hua Hua Hua...
Countless steel pipes fell from the sky!
The steel pipe was thick and as big as a child's wrist. It was cut into strips and fell neatly in front of him.
Pile into a high wall!
The exaggerated number of steel pipes is even more spectacular than the vegetables that fell all over the yard yesterday!
Is this refined iron?
Or stainless steel?
Throughout the Daqi Kingdom, bronze artifacts were rampant, and even coins were cast in bronze.
Iron is a rare thing, and steel is as valuable as gold.
The soldiers who heard the commotion ran out one after another and saw piles of steel pipes arranged neatly.
They were all stunned and shocked!
Lin Dajun stepped forward with eyes wide open, reaching out to touch the cold steel pipe...
Knocked again with his hand.
It's steel!
